ownerSignerRule.description: One signer: issuer compared exactly, subject a pattern anchored with ^ and $.

optionalDuration.description: A Go duration such as 15m; empty or 0 keeps the default or turns the setting off, as each setting says.

registry.description: The installation registry (host[/path], no scheme); the operator publishes the target snapshot to <registry>/pacto-targets.

url.description: The hub's https:// or wss:// URL; setting it makes this joined cluster a member that dials out to the hub.

caConfigMap.description: ConfigMap holding ca.crt, the CAs the hub's certificate may chain to.

enabled.description: List the candidate clusters the hub's GitOps and cluster managers know, as metadata only.

secretNamespaces.description: Namespaces where the operator may list Secret metadata for Argo CD and Flux cluster Secrets.

profile.description: Installation profile: default, hardened or idp, or a list of them (hardened wins where they disagree).

idp.description: Pieces profile idp installs with this release on a person's confirmation.

install.description: Install upstream Crossplane with this release. Needs profile idp; refused when Crossplane is already installed.
Install upstream Flux with this release (profile idp only).

enabled.description: Push each Crossplane XRD as an inferred offering to <registry>/pacto-inferred/crossplane-<clusterID>/services; needs registry and a cluster-wide operator.

registryPullSecret.description: namespace/name of an existing Secret that authenticates to registry; the chart grants get on that Secret only.

probing.description: Active probing: auto (on in namespaces labelled pacto.trianalab.io/observe=probing), on or off; true and false mean on and off. Empty means auto, or the deprecated enableProbing when it is set.

metricsObservation.description: Metrics observation: auto (on in namespaces labelled pacto.trianalab.io/observe=metrics), on or off; true and false mean on and off. ServiceMonitor discovery needs on. Empty means auto, or the deprecated enableMetricsObservation when it is set.

enableProbing.description: Deprecated: use controller.probing. Applies only while controller.probing is empty.

enableMetricsObservation.description: Deprecated: use controller.metricsObservation. Applies only while controller.metricsObservation is empty.

egressGatewayLogs.description: Istio egress gateway access logs: auto (find gateways and propose on), on (read their access log tail; adds pods/log get in istio-system) or "off" (quoted: a bare off is YAML false); true means on and false keeps meaning auto.

terraformStates.description: Remote Terraform or OpenTofu states the operator reads managed resources from through its workload identity: s3://<bucket>/<key>?region=<region>, gs://<bucket>/<object> or azurerm://<account>/<container>/<key>.

cloudInventory.description: The cloud whose inventory the operator reads through its workload identity: aws, gcp, azure or "off" (quoted: a bare off is YAML false, which also means off).

enabled.description: Kernel evidence: on, "off" (quoted: a bare off is YAML false) or auto, which follows nodeAgent.enabled; false keeps meaning auto.

repositories.description: oci:// references the dashboard reads beside the contracts it discovers from Pacto resources, such as golden paths, which are never deployed.

externalCatalog.description: Organization external catalog merged over Pacto's default, as oci://REPOSITORY@sha256:DIGEST. Empty uses only the default catalog.

auth.description: Sign-in for the dashboard: people sign in before it shows anything, every view follows their Kubernetes RBAC and delivery actions run with their own token.

mcp.description: MCP for AI agents at /mcp on the dashboard, with the dashboard's sign-in.

delivery.description: What the dashboard's delivery views read: where delivery runs, how its records are verified and where Mira answers.

trust.description: The trust config the dashboard verifies delivery records with, so History reads signed records.

backstage.description: The Backstage catalog the dashboard reads inferred owners, systems and dependencies from. The token is only for a configured url.

declare.description: Declare in the dashboard: the push Secret its writer alone uses.

index.description: The organization index the dashboard reads: auto reads <registry>/pacto-index when registry is set, none reads none.

observation.description: Offline OTLP/JSON trace exports mounted read-only into the dashboard. The dashboard also receives OTLP/HTTP JSON in the cluster; Pacto deploys no trace collector.

name.description: Stable Data Source identity. Reordering the list keeps every name.

file.description: Trace file name directly inside this source's mount directory. A single path segment: no directory separator, no whitespace, and no comma (the operator's trace-source flag is comma-delimited).

existingClaim.description: Existing PVC holding the trace export. A Kubernetes object name (DNS-1123 subdomain).

configMap.description: ConfigMap holding a small, static trace export. A Kubernetes object name (DNS-1123 subdomain).

resources.description: Resource requests and limits for the dashboard container

subjectPrefixes.description: Registry prefixes, each oci://<registry>/<path>/ ending in /, whose immutable revisions evidence may be stored on.

configKey.description: A key of the trust Secret holding a structured trust config; the server reads it as one by its .yaml or .yml extension.

resources.description: Resource requests and limits for the Evidence Server container

nodeAgent.description: The eBPF node agent DaemonSet (runs `pacto agent` from the pacto runtime image) in its own namespace, which the chart creates privileged for Pod Security.

image.description: Full image reference of the node agent; empty uses the runtime image the operator was built with

namespace.description: Dedicated agent namespace (a DNS-1123 label); not the release namespace

createNamespace.description: Create nodeAgent.namespace; false means it exists first with the privileged Pod Security labels

resources.description: Resource requests and limits for the node agent container

fingerprints.description: The workload managers and promoters this installation runs, as data; at most 64 entries in all

offer.description: The Pacto integration this promoter's detected row offers

allowEmptyHumanGroups.description: Deprecated and ignored: people and agents are told apart by how they sign in.

enabled.description: Removed: the chart always installs the admission policies with delivery, and rendering fails while this key is set.

allowUnguarded.description: Removed: use skipCapabilityCheck, and rendering fails while this key is set.

declare.description: Who may set a service owner with pacto declare, beside the owner's members.

trustedRoot.description: A Sigstore trusted_root.json owner changes are verified against; empty falls back to delivery.publishers.trustedRoot, else public-good Sigstore.

signing.description: The Sigstore a person's declaration is signed with in the dashboard; empty uses public-good Sigstore.

zot.description: The bundled zot registry. Every key besides enabled passes through to the upstream chart.

dex.description: The bundled Dex identity provider. Every key besides enabled passes through to the upstream chart.
